title: AGM / DGM Finance
description:
Your activities
   

  

* Key Responsibilities:Financial Reporting \& Analysis:
* Lead the preparation of timely and accurate financial reports, including monthly, calendar yearly, and India financial year.
* Analyze financial data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for cost reduction or revenue enhancement.
* Manage cost control, cost accounting, and ensure compliance with cost audit requirements.
* Variation analysis
* Budgeting \& Forecasting:
* Oversee the budgeting process, working with department heads to ensure alignment with organizational goals.
* Develop financial forecasts and models to assess the impact of business decisions and changing market conditions.
* Internal Controls \& Financial Systems:
* Ensure robust internal financial controls, processes, and procedures to protect company assets.
* Oversee the implementation and optimization of financial systems to improve operational efficiency.
* Team Leadership \& Development:
* Lead and develop the finance team, promoting continuous improvement and professional growth.
* Align team objectives with the broader finance department and organizational goals.
* Strategic Financial Support:
* Work closely with the CFO to develop and execute the company’s financial strategy, including capital allocation and investment
* opportunities.
* Provide financial insights to support mergers, acquisitions, and other key business initiatives.
* Audits:
* Supervision of audits
* Validation of audit reports
* Cost audits


 Your profile
   

  

* B.Com / M.Com
* Chartered Accountant


 Benefits:
   

  

* Work\-life integration
* Mobile working
* Flexible working hours
* Good development opportunities
* Employee discounts
* Attractive remuneration system
* Health initiatives
